name: Workflow A - Loan Product Discovery (Web Crawler)

parameter.name: User-Agent
parameter.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

parameters.query: SELECT content_hash, last_extracted FROM page_cache WHERE url = $1;

parameters.name: contents
parameters.value: =[{"parts":[{"text":"Extract loan criteria as JSON with fields: product_name, interest_rate (number), min_income (monthly number), min_score (number), min_age (number), max_age (number), allowed_employment (array of salaried/self_employed) from text: " + $node["Sanitize & Hash Page"].json.clean_text.substring(0, 1500)}]}]

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO loan_products (
  source_site, product_name, interest_rate, min_income, min_score, max_score,
  min_age, max_age, allowed_employment, qualitative_notes, is_active, last_seen_at
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3::numeric, $4::numeric, $5::int, $6::int,
  $7::int, $8::int, $9::text[], $10, TRUE, NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (source_site, product_name) DO UPDATE SET
  interest_rate = EXCLUDED.interest_rate,
  min_income = EXCLUDED.min_income,
  min_score = EXCLUDED.min_score,
  max_score = EXCLUDED.max_score,
  min_age = EXCLUDED.min_age,
  max_age = EXCLUDED.max_age,
  allowed_employment = EXCLUDED.allowed_employment,
  qualitative_notes = EXCLUDED.qualitative_notes,
  is_active = TRUE,
  last_seen_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO page_cache (url, content_hash, last_checked_at, last_extracted)
VALUES ($11, $12, NOW(), $13::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (url) DO UPDATE SET
  content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
  last_checked_at = NOW(),
  last_extracted = EXCLUDED.last_extracted;
INSERT INTO crawl_runs (started_at, status, used_llm, notes) VALUES (NOW(), 'ok', $1::boolean, $2);
